decisions.reason: Organic sliced ham is part of the organic range the firm has publicly committed to expanding, so dropping it would contradict its announced direction and write off its investment in organic certification and ranges.
Organic Kasseler belongs to the visibly promoted organic line, and any weak results can still be put down to the market for organic products still developing.
Organic pepper salami fits the firm's strategic organic expansion and uses its existing maturation facilities, so management would persist with it.
The exotic teriyaki aspic was announced as a one-year creation for the deli counter and is far from the firm's traditional identity, so little would need to be justified if it were quietly retired.
The fennel salami got its own dedicated web page, a visible commitment that management would be reluctant to reverse, and it sits close to the core salami business.
The classic veal liver pâté fits the firm's craftsmanship heritage and its established pâté line, so continuing it is easy to justify.
